rules.path: Each {name} in the template is replaced by its parameter: a string, or an integer as its decimal. Every UTF-8 byte outside the RFC 3986 unreserved set (A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~) becomes %XX in uppercase hex, "/" included. Refused (invalid_path_param): an empty value, "." or "..", a value of another type, text with no UTF-8 form (a lone UTF-16 surrogate; tested per language, since JSON does not carry one portably). A parameter not given: missing_path_param.
rules.query: name=value pairs joined by "&" in the order given, both encoded as the path is. A value is a string, an integer (decimal) or a boolean ("true"/"false"); null leaves the pair out; anything else is invalid_query_param. No pairs: no "?".
rules.fetch: Every target is one a WHATWG URL (and so fetch) sends unchanged, so the path and query signed are the ones on the request line.

cases.name: plain_ids
cases.description: Ids and names made only of unreserved characters are sent as they are.

cases.name: query_in_given_order
cases.description: Query parameters go in the order given (the operation table's), never sorted.

cases.name: boolean_and_integer_query
cases.description: Booleans are "true" and "false", integers plain decimals.

cases.name: null_query_left_out
cases.description: A parameter given as null (or not given) is not sent at all.

cases.name: empty_string_query_sent
cases.description: An empty string is a value: sent as "name=".

cases.name: no_query
cases.description: No query parameters: no "?" at all.

cases.name: reserved_characters_in_path
cases.description: Every reserved character in a path parameter is percent-encoded, "/" included, so it can never add a path segment.

cases.name: unreserved_kept
cases.description: Letters, digits, "-", ".", "_" and "~" stay as they are.

cases.name: utf8_in_path_and_query
cases.description: Non-ASCII is encoded as its UTF-8 bytes, uppercase hex.

cases.name: reserved_characters_in_query
cases.description: Query names and values are encoded the same way, so "&", "=" and "+" in a value stay inside it.

cases.name: integer_path_parameter
cases.description: An integer path parameter (encodeXrpAddress addressTag) is its decimal.

cases.name: dot_segment_with_text
cases.description: Dots inside a value are fine; only a whole "." or ".." segment is refused.

cases.name: empty_path_parameter
cases.description: An empty path parameter would leave an empty segment.

cases.name: dot_path_parameter
cases.description: "." is a dot segment a URL removes, which would change the path signed.

cases.name: boolean_path_parameter
cases.description: Path parameters are strings or integers.

cases.name: fractional_query_value
cases.description: Query values are strings, integers or booleans; no documented parameter is fractional.
